application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

cells_liion.source: one cell per measured cell-voltage channel in the released device files
cells_liion.note: 5,241 released cell-voltage channels. The paper's 5,234 (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.xcrp.2026.103154, Table 1, p. 3) is the authors' feature-extraction count: dataProcess.ipynb get_device_voltages keeps columns with sum >= 1,000 and std > 0, which drops 7 constant-voltage cells of device d01d1f73; the released cell table holds 5,234 distinct cells in 5,248 rows (14 cells carry two labels).

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.note: Cell-voltage columns with at least one positive value, summed over 271 device files.

energy_mwh.note: The release does not provide a complete nominal pack-energy rating or configuration from which to compute one.

span_unit_years.note: Sum of first-to-last dateTime over 271 device files in predefinedDataset/data.

obs_hours.note: Observation-hours are not used when calendar spans are measurable or no cadence is available.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://zenodo.org/records/18328701; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
